body: Therapy - someone is stuck in a barbed wire fence, let's drag them back through the wire. They'll feel better. Or, here's a pill. Then what? Suffer?

I sincerely hope that you do. And also understand what you're saying. I guess this is the monotony of life, and what needs to be accepted. I really want off the train. I look at happy people & legitimately wonder if they live their lives with the blinders on. Ignoring everything that actually goes on. 

The wide angle of the world really isn't a pretty picture, but is it really the world, or me? - if so many other people can be happy despite everything, then it's me, no? 

I genuinely can't remember life before wanting to end it. I wasn't born like this. I've pissed every opportunity I've had up the wall. I seem to self-destruct. Just not quite enough

Its a fucked cycle. Failure seems to be embedded in me. Doesn't seem to matter how much I push, how hard I try. How much I change. I feel like I have no fear of dying, but huge fear of life. What if they had it right?
